name: Blasphemers
overview: Scripture solemnly warns against blasphemy, especially the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost, which is described as an unforgivable sin leading to eternal condemnation (Matthew 12:31; Mark 3:29; Luke 12:10). The resistance to the Holy Spirit is portrayed as a hardened, stubborn opposition reminiscent of the rebellion of Israel's ancestors (Acts 7:51). Furthermore, the seriousness of blaspheming is underscored by the severe judgment awaiting those who treat the Son of God and the Spirit of grace with contempt (Hebrews 10:29). Believers are exhorted to live in holiness, avoiding false accusations and strife, as a reflection of a transformed heart (Titus 2:3).
